newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street stocks seen higher at open after data.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street stocks seen higher at open after data.

text.p: Wall Street stocks were expected to gain at the open on Thursday, as the bond market firmed after the release of second quarter gross domestic product data.
In the second quarter, gross domestic product growth showed an above-forecast 2.2 percent annualized gain but the price deflator posted its smallest rise since 1964.
"We have more of the low inflation scenerio," said Peter Cardillo, director of research at Westfalia Investments.
The Standard & Poor's 500 futures index rose 1.85 points to 958.95. The long bond added 15/32 to yield 6.25 percent.
